items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: That's going back as far as Texas Joe(?), had a thing called a... They used to have a box made especially for your drums...

ctx.x: I see. When you were with A.G. Allen, I'm sure that you had a chance to see other drummers. Did you notice how they took care of their drums? What kinds of things did they do to keep the drumheads in good shape. And what kinds of things did you do?
Well, they didn't use no... They used them... there were drum covers. That's going back as far as Texas Joe(?), had a thing called a... They used to have a box made especially for your drums...
